title: Nebius Climbs 4% Despite Michael Burry’s Bigger Bearish Bet; CoreWeave Ticks Up, Cloudflare Slips
detail:
Nebius Climbs 4% Despite Michael Burry’s Bigger Bearish Bet; CoreWeave Ticks Up, Cloudflare Slips
David Moadel
Tue, September 29, 2026 at 8:56 AM PDT 5 min read
NBIS
CRWV
BNP.PA
NET
SKYY
Explore stocks on Coinbase
Trading disclosure
Quick Read

Burry swapped his Nebius short for leveraged June puts betting on a steep drop, yet Nebius climbed 4% and CoreWeave rose 2%.

The cloud ETF SKYY held flat with zero Nebius exposure, while BNP Paribas set a $399 Outperform target countering Burry's bearish thesis.

Building a portfolio and living off one are two completely different skills, and almost nobody teaches the second. This problem is what The Definitive Guide to Retirement Income helps, and it is free today. Read more here. (Sponsor)

Famous "Big Short" investor Michael Burry has apparently hardened his stance against Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS), and Nebius stock is climbing anyway. Nebius stock is up 4% to $241.80 early in the session, leaving NBIS shares up 189% year to date. That rally runs in the opposite direction from how a larger, more leveraged position from a well-known bear would normally land.

Photo by Astrid Stawiarz/Getty Images

CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) stock is also rising 2% to $86.93, a smaller advance for another artificial intelligence (AI) name Burry cited in his post. Cloudflare (NYSE:NET) stock is slipping 0.6% to $351.96, a modest pullback that sets the network security company apart from the AI infrastructure trade.

The First Trust Cloud Computing ETF (NASDAQ:SKYY) is practically unchanged, a sign that the cloud group as a whole is sitting still while Nebius climbs. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) is down 0.3%, leaving the broad market slightly lower.

Burry Swaps His Nebius Short for June Puts

After Monday's close, Burry wrote on Substack that he had covered his short common-stock position in Nebius and replaced it with June put options in the double-digit strike price range. According to Burry, the same shift covered short positions in several other AI-linked names, including CoreWeave, where he hadn't yet been able to buy puts at an attractive price. This is the first full trading day since that post.

title: MongoDB shares sink 18% as CEO Desai leaves for Meta
detail:
MongoDB shares sink 18% as CEO Desai leaves for Meta
Proactive
Mon, September 28, 2026 at 8:50 AM PDT 1 min read
MDB
NOW
META
NET
Explore stocks on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

Shares of MongoDB Inc (NASDAQ:MDB) fell more than 18% Monday morning after CEO Chirantan "CJ" Desai left to lead a new Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META, XETRA:FB2A, SIX:FB) business bringing its AI tools to corporate customers.

MongoDB appointed Dev Ittycheria interim CEO.

Desai will report directly to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg as chief enterprise platform officer, a newly created role. His mandate is to turn Meta's AI stack into products and services that companies can deploy for their own businesses.

Meta said Monday its new Meta Enterprise Platform would bring AI models, agents and tools to businesses, including the newly launched Muse, Meta Business Agent and coding tools.

Before joining MongoDB, Desai led product and engineering at Cloudflare and spent nearly eight years at ServiceNow Inc (NYSE:NOW, XETRA:4S0) (ServiceNow Inc (NYSE:NOW, XETRA:4S0), ServiceNow Inc (NYSE:NOW, XETRA:4S0)), including as president and chief operating officer.

MongoDB provides database software for building and running applications, with tools for data management, search, analytics, and AI. The company is searching for a permanent replacement for Desai, who had taken over the CEO role from Ittycheria.
